$comment: #4393: every constant a formal/<family>/*.cfg assigns (`=` or `<-`), and every module `Name == TRUE|FALSE` that is not a `<-` target, is classified here, per family. `pins`: the constant mirrors a code choice; `value` is what every `\* expect: pass` config resolves it to (its `=` value, the definition its `<-` names, or the module's `Name == <literal>`), and `test`/`title` name a test a run reaches, in a file vitest collects, that drives the real code and asserts that behaviour, so flipping the code reds the test and flipping the model alone reds tests/config/tla-switch-pins.test.ts. `also` names further tests when one value encodes several behaviours. `narrowedBy` admits a value an as-built config uses only to cut the explored schedules, with its reason. `notCodeChoice` and `deferred` groups carry a reason for each member, and tests/config/tla-switch-pins.test.ts pins the counts of deferred and notCodeChoice members exactly, so every move between them is a visible edit. Flipping a model value and this value together, without the code, reds neither the gate nor the pin, so a change to a value here is a reviewer's call. A PR that changes a pinned behaviour flips the constant, its configs and this value together (AGENTS.md shape 68).

AuthorBranch.title: keeps the authorship of a brand-new file whose write is on the kept branch (#3603)

AuthorIdentity.title: ends bash authorship when another writer changes the bytes (#4131 R1)

BlockRelease.title: refuses a %s oldText edit in the same run once the blocked read's call ended

BranchFilter.title: blocks an edit backed only by a read on the abandoned branch (A1)

BridgeNoAdvance.title: ends the authorship a ${provenance ?? "co-process"} write lands on

also.title: spends an observed bridge license after one whole-file write (SpendLicense)

CoverageCheck.title: sizes a raced read from the delivered text, not from lines another writer appended

CreationHandlerEvidence.title: does not credit a write that lands between the host write and its tool_result (CreationAtResult)

narrowedBy.\"atomic\": The drain runs inside the turn boundary, so no /tree lands between its settle and its write: a schedule the fenced drain also takes. Configs that do not test the drain's timing use it to cut states (formal/read-guard/README.md, Switches).

FileTimeCheck.title: leaves FileTime to recordWritten, so a write after it stays visible on an unhashed attachment

FormatStamp.title: does not credit the deferred format's bytes to an unhashed read (UnhashedFormatStamp)

HandlerEvidence.title: does not credit a write that lands after pi's read and before its tool_result (EvidenceAtResult)

InjectNamesAuthorship.title: allows the next edit after a bash write and its own oldText edits, also after a branch move (#4387)

KeepEmptyScope.title: keeps the in-flight line refused after a format drain and a move (#4387 S14)

MtimeAuthored.title: blocks zero-read edit on a file another writer touched after the guard started (#3520)

OldTextNeedsNamedRead.title: keeps a line another writer changed during an own oldText edit refused when only a bridge read was there (#4387 S12)

OldTextRetires.title: does not retire a write's authorship at its own oldText edit (#4387)

OwnEditRescue.title: keeps another writer's change stale after an own positional edit (UnhashedOwnEditRescue)

OwnEditSkipsReloc.title: does not record a relocated edit at the agent's line numbers (OwnEditRelocInsert)

PipelineCreditsOldText.title: makes no authorship from an oldText edit of a file the conversation only read (#4387 G3)

ProvisionalCredit.title: records a relative nested read under its parent's transcript identity, after a provisional record keyed by its own call

RecordAuthoritative.title: allows a one-line edit at the attachment's line numbers (AutofixFalseBlock)

RecordOwnEdit.title: allows re-editing the line the agent just wrote (OwnReEdit)

RelocFromLatest.title: does not relocate from the read that delivered the first line when a newer read delivered the last (SpanSnapshotFixAnyReloc)

RetireAtWrite.title: does not let an own bash write re-author bytes another writer changed (#4131 F6 P2)

RevokeFailedRead.title: drops the capture of a read that errored, so an oldText edit of unseen lines is refused

SnapshotCheck.title: blocks a spanning edit when the SECOND read's line went stale

SpanSnapshot.title: does not let a newer context-only read cancel a stale line (ContextSuppress)

WholeVouchesPastEnd.title: lets an older read speak for a line past a newer whole-file read's end (WholeVouchesPastEnd)

ZeroReadInjects.title: keeps a bash write's whole-file authorship vouching after its own positional edit (#4387)
